data: What is the macro-label of the x-axis?

The x-axis represents the F1 score on RST Discourse Treebank. The y-axis represents the accuracy on Yelp Reviews. The caption indicates that the figure shows how parsing F1 performance affects accuracy on the Yelp review task when varying the amount of training data for the discourse parser. Therefore, the macro-label of the x-axis is "F1 on RST Discourse Treebank".
